name: foodguide
description: Unofficial Don't Starve food guide and recipe calculator

scripts.dev: npm run generate-sprites && http-server html -p 8080 -o /index.htm -a 127.0.0.1 -i false -c -1 -g
scripts.format: prettier --write "html/**/*.js" "tests/**/*.js" "scripts/**/*.js" html/index.htm html/index.html "html/style/*.css" ".github/workflows/*.yml" eslint.config.js .prettierrc.json package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "html/**/*.js" "tests/**/*.js" "scripts/**/*.js" html/index.htm html/index.html "html/style/*.css" ".github/workflows/*.yml" eslint.config.js .prettierrc.json package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:browser
scripts.fix: npm run format && npm run lint:fix

author: bluehexagons
